Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 103: You Have Her Perfume Scent on You

"The midterm exams are from Wednesday to Friday this week. Everyone, open your English textbooks. I'll outline the scope of the exam first."

After outlining the exam scope, Class Eight's English teacher, Teacher Dingxiang, said with a smile, "During the placement exam at the start of the semester, I noticed that some students' English scores were still quite borderline, so I discussed it with the other English teacher."

"For this midterm exam, the English portion will follow the college entrance exam format, with a total score of 150."

"For students who score below 100, I will recommend you attend the school's Sunday tutoring class, which will be taught by me and Teacher Wang from Class Nine."

Several subject teachers had already said similar things.

This was probably a tradition at Fuyi High.

Although the regular class schedule seemed relaxed, during the so-called club activity time after the seventh period, most students had to attend training for their academic competition clubs.

And Saturday afternoons, which fell under the category of club activities, were also when the competition clubs held their group tests.

Then came Sunday. The daytime was supposed to be for rest, with students only needing to return to school for evening self-study.

But if you were significantly weak in a particular subject, your teacher would pull you to school early for extra lessons.

If your weaknesses were more severe, with two or three subjects needing tutoring, your entire Sunday afternoon would be completely taken up.

In this way, the weekend was practically no different from a regular school week. You'd go home Saturday evening and have to be back at school by noon on Sunday.

Sleep in a little, and the whole weekend was gone.

Of course, these Saturday and Sunday activities were not mandatory.

If you didn't want to come, the school wouldn't force you.

But your parents certainly would...

Compared to the high school from Li Luo's past life, Fuyi High's methods were a bit gentler, but the effect and purpose were more or less the same, finally giving Li Luo a taste of something familiar.

However, with a strong student body, the students' own motivation was much greater. In fact, many were willing to come to school for supplementary lessons voluntarily.

"Of course, if your score is over 100 but you still feel you need tutoring, you can also sign up."

Teacher Ding looked at Jin Yuting and said with a smile, "Jin Yuting, please take down the names. Any student who needs to sign up can register with the class representative."

"Okay, Teacher."

After the last class of the morning ended.

Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang had already charged out of the classroom, becoming Class Eight's cafeteria stormtroopers.

Li Luo stood up and stretched, saying to Yan Zhusheng, "I'm going to the restroom. Wait for me for a bit."

"Oh."

After Li Luo left, Ying Chanxi had already come down from upstairs and walked into the Class Eight classroom. Seeing only Yan Zhusheng, she asked, puzzled, "Where's Li Luo?"

"He went to the restroom," Yan Zhusheng said, pointing in the direction of the washrooms.

"Oh, perfect." Ying Chanxi trotted over to Yan Zhusheng's desk, pulled out a small box from behind her back, and stuffed it into Yan Zhusheng's desk drawer. "Keep this safe."

"Hmm?" Yan Zhusheng blinked, still a bit slow to react. She looked down into her drawer and could only see the outline of a palm-sized box, unable to make out what it was. "This is?"

"A gift for you." Ying Chanxi winked at her and chuckled, covering her mouth. "You can open it after you get back from lunch. Remember not to let the teachers see it."

"Oh... Thank you, Xixi." A faint look of pleasure appeared on Yan Zhusheng's face. She hadn't expected to receive a gift.

"You're welcome." Having delivered the gift, Ying Chanxi turned to leave the classroom, looking back to say, "I still have to go to math competition training, so I won't have lunch with you guys. I'm off."

"Okay, bye-bye." Yan Zhusheng waved, watching Ying Chanxi's figure disappear around the corner. She glanced down at the gift in her drawer again, her mood lifting a little more.

"You look like something good has happened." After using the restroom, Li Luo called for Yan Zhusheng from the back door. Seeing the look on her face, he immediately commented.

"Something did," Yan Zhusheng nodded, her steps somewhat lighter.

"I just went to the restroom. What good thing could have possibly happened to you?" Li Luo said, surprised.

He had just said it casually, but it turned out to be true?

"Guess."

"Guess if I'll guess."

"I guess you will guess."

"Then I won't guess."

"Li Luo, you're so childish."

"You have the nerve to say that about me?"

The two arrived at the cafeteria, and after getting their food, they saw Xu Youyu sitting alone quietly in a corner. They stopped their childish guessing game and walked straight over.

At the same time, Shao Youpeng, who had just gotten his food, also spotted Xu Youyu. Seeing Yan Zhusheng and Li Luo sit with her, an idea struck him. He quietly made his way to the empty seat beside Li Luo. "Ahem... Li Luo, is anyone sitting here?"

"No."

"Then is it okay if I sit here?"

"Of course, you can."

Hearing Li Luo's answer, Shao Youpeng's face lit up. He carried his tray and sat next to Li Luo, directly across from Xu Youyu.

"When did you guys get so close?" Xu Youyu, seated opposite them, looked curious.

As the former monitor of Class One of the second year, now Class Sixteen, Xu Youyu recognized Shao Youpeng.

But after the classes were reorganized, Shao Youpeng chose the science track, so they were no longer in the same class.

"Have you forgotten?" Shao Youpeng said cheekily, "I'm the bassist in the rock club. Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng are my club mates."

"Oh, right, I think I remember that." Xu Youyu recalled, surprised. "So you'll all be performing together at the sports meet?"

"That's right." Shao Youpeng puffed out his chest. He suddenly realized that being friends with Li Luo was actually a pretty good thing. At least he could openly sit with Xu Youyu and even chat with her.

On this point, his younger cousin really needed to learn a thing or two from him.

After all, there was only one Li Luo. Although he had a good relationship with several of the girls currently recognized as school beauties, he couldn't be juggling so many at once, right?

During their time at the rock club, Shao Youpeng could tell that there was something going on between Li Luo and his classmate, Yan Zhusheng.

So why couldn't he become friends with Li Luo?

With this thought, Shao Youpeng became even more talkative at the table. "Li Luo's guitar skills are excellent. Although he wasn't a member of our rock club before, this time he's stepping up to save the day, joining at the last minute to fill a gap for us. We really have to thank him."

Li Luo glanced at Shao Youpeng in surprise, thinking to himself that he wasn't nearly as great as he was being made out to be. It was all because he'd been tricked into it by Yan Zhusheng and Niu Qingling.

"Then you all better work hard," Xu Youyu encouraged with a smile. "It'll make my job as student council president a little easier."

After the National Day holiday, the third-year Xue Yongbin had stepped down, and Xu Youyu had taken over as the student council president, coordinating various school affairs.

This included large-scale events like the sports meet. Led by the director of the academic affairs office and with the PE teachers handling specific arrangements, the student council acted as a bridge between teachers and students, contacting the monitors and sports representatives of each class to carry out a series of preparations and plans.

Things like the rock club participating in the opening ceremony performance had to be registered with the student council.

"Don't worry. Once we've practiced together for a while, the performance will definitely be spectacular," Shao Youpeng promised, patting his chest in front of Xu Youyu.

"Then, as the student council president, it shouldn't be a problem for me to come and observe the results of your practice, right?" Xu Youyu said, her eyes twinkling.

"Of course not!" Shao Youpeng agreed in a heartbeat.

After finishing their meal, Xu Youyu said to Li Luo, "Don't forget the literary club activity this evening. We're voting for the club president."

Li Luo made an OK gesture and returned to the classroom with Yan Zhusheng.

After the bell for the lunch break rang, Li Luo rested his head on his desk, ready to sleep.

A moment later, his arm was suddenly tapped twice.

Lifting his eyes, Li Luo saw Yan Zhusheng secretly take something out of her drawer and pass it to him.

Looking closely, he saw it was a single wireless Bluetooth earbud.

"When did you get new earbuds?" Li Luo was a little surprised. He took the small, exquisite white earbud and placed it in his ear.

Soothing, gentle music was playing inside, perfect as a lullaby for a midday nap.

"It's a gift from Xixi," Yan Zhusheng whispered.

"Huh?" Li Luo froze for a second, suddenly feeling that the earbud was a little hot against his ear.

(End of Chapter)
